input.goal: A 30-second countdown of Barcelona's five legends in seven chapters, each with its exact chapter line, in a warm colour look.
input.creator_request: Make it 30 seconds. Title: "The 5 legends of Barcelona". Story edit in 7 chapters, warm colour look. Use every uploaded file in chapter order. Show each chapter line word for word. Chapter 1 · Messi, Barça shirt · 3s · Messi is only #2. Chapter 2 · older bearded Cerdà, then blocks from above · 5s · #5 Ildefons Cerdà drew the city grid. Those cut corners? On purpose. Chapter 3 · young Picasso, Els Quatre Gats · 5s · #4 Pablo Picasso moved here at 13 and had his first solo show here. Chapter 4 · Olympic stadium · 5s · #3 Freddie Mercury & Montserrat Caballé: “Barcelona”, their Olympic song. Freddie died before the Games. Chapter 5 · second Messi, Camp Nou · 5s · #2 Lionel Messi. First deal: a paper napkin, at 13. 672 goals later… Chapter 6 · young bearded Gaudí, Casa Batlló, basilica towers · 5s · #1 Antoni Gaudí gave Barcelona its skyline, and he’s buried inside his unfinished church. Chapter 7 · wide basilica · 2s · Who’s missing?
shot_labels: #5 Ildefons Cerdà drew the city grid. Those cut corners? On purpose.
#4 Pablo Picasso moved here at 13 and had his first solo show here.
#3 Freddie Mercury & Montserrat Caballé: “Barcelona”, their Olympic song. Freddie died before the Games.
#2 Lionel Messi. First deal: a paper napkin, at 13. 672 goals later…
#1 Antoni Gaudí gave Barcelona its skyline, and he’s buried inside his unfinished church.
